name: translation-key-helper
description: Check the live Kuril i18n library, review reuse and missing keys in two confirmation stages, then save, verify, and release approved translations.

interface.shortDescription: Review, confirm, and publish Kuril translation keys.
interface.longDescription: Check live duplicates, follow verified Kuril classification patterns, obtain two user confirmations, then save, verify, and release approved Chinese, English, and Thai entries.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this design or document against Kuril. Show reusable keys and missing copy for my first confirmation, then propose missing keys with translations and classification evidence for my second confirmation before saving and releasing.
